## Problem statement
What problem does this solve, and for which role (author / reviewer / admin / operator)?

## Proposed solution
Describe the behaviour you would like. Include API shapes or UI sketches if helpful.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches and why they were rejected.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given ..., when ..., then ...
- [ ] Automated test added (unit / Selenium)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `architecture/SRS_SUMMARY.md`)

## Additional context
Links, references, screenshots.
